title: Work inbox
empty: No loaded items match this filter.
unconfirmed: Read state is unconfirmed. Reconnect to read stored state before trying again.
updated: Inbox rows updated: {count}. Pending approvals stay unread until settled.
windowNote: Counts cover the loaded window: 50 inbox items plus 50 pending approvals, up to 100 notifications. Mark all affects all owned ordinary rows, not approval decisions.
streamNote: Live updates are process-local hints, not a durable activity feed. Reconnect always reads a fresh owner snapshot; no action is replayed.
